definitions: A landmark or area selected by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) for having cultural, historical, scientific or other form of significance, and legally protected by international treaties.
A site on the list maintained by the international World Heritage Programme administered by the UNESCO World Heritage Committee.
examples: The Great Barrier Reef is a World Heritage Site.
Many ancient ruins are designated as World Heritage Sites.
Protecting a World Heritage Site is a global responsibility.
